v0.6.0.description:
New apworld and yaml. dinput8.dll is the same as before.

Changelog:
- Added a tracker on the world map showing progress towards unlocking the final level
- Added ingame messages of found/sent/recieved items
- Added trials as checks as an option
- Added traps as an option
- Added different quality of life options in yaml
- Fixed a visual map bug where completed levels still showed as 0%
- Fixed some logic errors
v0.6.0.title: Version 0.6.0

v0.6.1.description:
A few bug fixes. 
dinput8.dll has to be installed again along with los.apworld.

- Fixed the game crashing on launch after closing it after beating a level
- Fixed Focus Scroll accidentally being given when owning Shadow Magic
- Fixed Hook Tip accidentally being given when owning Spiked Chain
- Fixed a trial logic error on The Dead Bog
- Fixed a bug where trials wouldnt enable
